name: @synapsedesk/api-gateway-java
//: A MAVEN project with an npm manifest, for the reason rag-service's manifest gives: turbo dispatches by workspace, and a directory with no package.json is not one. It declares NO `build`, `lint` or `test`, because turbo skips a task a workspace does not define and `npm test` must stay runnable without a JDK — Maven owns those three, through `./mvnw`.
